bigfive.cardIntro: Personality dimensions are five core traits that help explain how people tend to think, feel, behave and interact with others.
bigfive.d1_0: You're open to new things, curious, creative and love to explore. Different ideas, experiences and perspectives easily catch your interest.
bigfive.d1_1: You balance novelty and habit. You enjoy new experiences, but you don't give up the methods you know and trust.
bigfive.d1_2: You may lean towards tradition and habit, preferring concrete, familiar ways of doing things.
bigfive.d2_0: You're organized, responsible, well-planned and goal-driven. You tend to finish what you start and stick to long-term goals.
bigfive.d2_1: You balance planning with flexibility. You can be organized and goal-focused when needed, and spontaneous when it suits.
bigfive.d2_2: You may be more spontaneous and flexible, going with in-the-moment decisions. Planning and keeping things orderly can be a challenge.
bigfive.d3_0: You draw energy from social settings, love to connect, are outgoing and don't hold back from expressing yourself.
bigfive.d3_1: You can enjoy both social settings and time on your own. Depending on the setting, you can be outgoing or calm and observant.
bigfive.d3_2: You may be more introverted, calm and observant. You might enjoy time alone and use your social energy more carefully.
bigfive.d4_0: You're empathetic, understanding, helpful and cooperative. You care about others' feelings and try to keep harmony in your relationships.
bigfive.d4_1: You're open to cooperation, but you have your boundaries. You value others' feelings and aren't shy about standing up for your own views.
bigfive.d4_2: You may be more competitive, questioning, independent and direct. You don't hesitate to stand up for your own views.
bigfive.d5_0: You're emotionally balanced, resilient under stress and able to stay calm in tough situations. You may be more steady in managing your feelings.
bigfive.d5_1: You can stay calm most of the time, though intense stress may affect you emotionally. Overall, you manage your feelings in a balanced way.
bigfive.d5_2: You may be more sensitive to emotional ups and downs, anxiety and stress. Events may affect you more deeply.

landing.aDesc: Do you build bridges with people, or keep your distance?
landing.c1b: When you meet a friend of a friend, you just trust them: no questions, no research. That's exactly what Ahenk does. No searching, no picking. The algorithm chooses; you just show up.
landing.c1t: Does meeting strangers have to be this hard?
landing.c2b: To join, you verify your phone number, your ID is checked and you complete a short video verification. Everyone at your table has been through the same process. No anonymous accounts, no fake profiles.
landing.c3b: Every meetup takes place at restaurants and cafés in your city. The week's venue is chosen based on your personality profile and venue preference, and you get the address and time before the meetup. No special deals or extra fees. You just pay your own bill.
landing.c4b: Group tables have 4–6 people, Duo tables 2, and Bring a Buddy tables 4. In Duo meetups the match is confirmed both ways: the person across from you went through the same process and agreed to the same terms.
landing.c5b: You can't see the others' last names, jobs or ages in advance, and they can't see yours. You meet on the night. That means both excitement and equality.
landing.c5t: You don't need to know anyone.
landing.c6b: There's a review system after every meetup. If there's someone you don't want to be matched with again, just say so and you'll never meet them again. If you report something serious, our team steps in to review it, and that person's account is banned permanently and never allowed to sign up again.
landing.cDesc: How much order and meaning do you bring to your life?
landing.citiesSub: Tables are set up every week in the cities below.
landing.comfortTitle: Why Will You Feel at Ease?
landing.eDesc: When you walk into a room, do you take energy or give it?
landing.f1b: New faces at a group table, or one person at a Duo table. Both are waiting for you.
landing.f2b: Date, venue and booking: all sorted. All you have to do is head out.
landing.f3b: Nothing random about it. You'll sit with people you'll genuinely click with.
landing.fillTest: Take the Ocean Big5 personality test now. Ahenk takes care of the rest.
landing.groupFull: This week's group tables are full.
landing.hurry: Grab your seat before the tables fill up.
landing.k1b: The questions you answer before joining Ahenk aren't an ordinary survey. Every answer is a signal designed to describe you. Your way of thinking, your social energy, the role you play at the table and your venue preference all come together into a profile that's uniquely yours.
landing.k1t: Not a test, but a profile.
landing.k2b: Our matching engine uses the OCEAN (Big Five) model, the gold standard of personality research. Validated on millions of people since the 1980s, it measures five core dimensions of personality: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Emotional Balance. These aren't opposites but spectrums, and your place on them is never the same as anyone else's.
landing.k3b: Once your profile is ready, the algorithm steps in. It matches you not just with people like you, but with people you can truly click with. Your field of work, age and venue preference count too, but they're supporting factors. Personality fit carries the real weight.
landing.k4b: Matching closes on a set day each week. The algorithm reviews the profiles gathered so far, brings together the groups or pairs with the highest compatibility and sets the table. All you do is wait for confirmation.
landing.k4t: How is a table set up?
landing.k5b: After every meetup, Ahenk creates a short AI report about the table: the group's overall compatibility, standout personality dynamics and the table's energy, just for you, just for that evening.
landing.k6b: Group tables look for harmony; Duo meetups look for depth. For pairs, the algorithm works much more precisely: age fit, personality balance and shared expectations come first. The person across from you isn't random. They're someone who truly matches you.
landing.k7b: Personality is steady, but context changes. That's why your OCEAN profile is updated every 6 months, so the you of today meets the matches of today.
landing.kankaFull: This week's Bring a Buddy tables are full.
landing.knowsTitle: How Does Ahenk Get to Know You?
landing.nDesc: What's your relationship with your emotions like?
landing.oDesc: How open are you to new ideas, new faces, new evenings?

landing.primeRule3: If you cancel, any credits you have at that moment stay valid with no time limit until you use them; there are no refunds.
landing.primeRule4: Subscriptions bought through the App Store or Google Play are cancelled there; subscriptions bought with iyzico are cancelled on the website or in the app.
landing.q1: Honestly, I was nervous about going at first because I didn't know what to expect, but I'm so glad I went. I've become good friends with a few people from that table.
landing.q2: The concept felt unusual at first, but now I use it all the time for weekend plans.
landing.q3: I met a girl I'd never met before, one-on-one. I'm shy, but she was literally like my mirror image. I didn't feel like a stranger at all.
landing.q4: I was matched at a group table and met genuinely great people. The conversation flowed. It felt like we already knew each other.
landing.q5: I just wanted a Duo table with someone to talk to, and that's exactly what I got. It was ridiculously fun.
landing.quote: "Every week, in your city, a table that fits you."
landing.s1b: Pick your situation with a few taps. No need to explain at length. In that moment, your only job is to look after yourself.
landing.s2b: When you send an emergency request, your location is shared with the police and our team follows it until it's resolved. You don't have to describe where you are. As you move, we move with you.
landing.s3b: A dedicated team is on call 24/7. From the moment your request arrives until it's resolved, they stay with you and never drop it halfway.
landing.s4b: The details are shared with the police.
landing.sosHope: We hope you never need it. But knowing it's there changes the night.
landing.sosP1: This isn't just another feature on a list. It's Ahenk's strongest layer of safety. You won't find a system like this in most apps like ours, because our job doesn't end once the table is set.
landing.sosP2: The night goes well, the table breaks up, everyone heads home. When you leave, we don't. On the way home, in the back seat of a car, in those last minutes before you close your door, Emergency Help is still in your pocket. It switches on at 20:00, meetup time, and stays with you until 08:00 the next morning.
landing.sosP3: We know the little calculations a woman makes before a night out: How will I get home? Who do I let know? What if something happens? We built this system by taking those questions seriously, so our women members can sit at that table at ease and enjoy every bit of the night.
landing.sosTitle: We're with you even after you leave the table.
landing.whyClick: Why do you click with some people from the first minute?
landing.whyClickBody: With some people you talk for hours and don't notice your coffee going cold. With others, even sharing a table is tiring. That's no accident. We bring science to your table.

ocean.agreeableness_level0: You have a strong point of view and don't let it go easily. You liven up debates at the table, but finding common ground can take time.
ocean.agreeableness_level1: You're open to cooperation, but you have your boundaries. At the table, you can make your voice heard and listen to others too.
ocean.agreeableness_level2: Your empathy runs high. With your gift for listening and bringing people together, you create a deep sense of comfort at every table you join.
ocean.conscientiousness_level0: You like to go with in-the-moment decisions. Spontaneity defines you more than planning. You bring surprise energy to the table, though consistency can be hard.
ocean.conscientiousness_level1: You're organized in some areas but keep your flexibility. At the table, you can get organized when needed and go with the flow when it suits.
ocean.conscientiousness_level2: You're goal-driven and consistent. In group dynamics, you're the quiet organizer who builds trust and keeps the table balanced and flowing.
ocean.extraversion_axisDesc: Social energy and interaction with others
ocean.extraversion_level0: Social settings drain you, while time alone recharges you. You shine in deep one-on-one connections, but busy group dynamics can be tiring.
ocean.extraversion_level1: You're neither fully introverted nor extroverted. It depends on the setting and the people. You bring a selective but high-quality energy to the table.
ocean.extraversion_level2: You draw energy from social settings. From the moment you sit down, you're the one who breaks the ice, starts conversations and warms up the room.
ocean.extraversion_traitDesc: Social energy, outgoingness and love of conversation
ocean.neuroticism_axisDesc: Emotional ups and downs and stress response
ocean.neuroticism_level0: Emotions affect you strongly and show to those around you. Keeping your balance in intense moments can be hard, but it's also part of what makes you you.
ocean.neuroticism_level1: Your emotional resilience is growing. You stay calm most of the time, though unexpected moments can occasionally throw you.
ocean.neuroticism_level2: You're on solid emotional ground. Even in heated debates you stay calm, bringing the most balanced and rational energy to the table.
ocean.openness_axisDesc: Openness to new experiences and ideas
ocean.openness_level0: You're cautious about new ideas and experiences. Familiar settings put you at ease, while uncertainty can be a challenge. At the table, you shine on safe topics.
ocean.openness_level1: You're curious but selective. You love diving deep into some topics, but you don't open the door to every idea. You bring a balanced contribution to the table.
ocean.openness_level2: You're completely open to ideas and experiences. At the table, you're the main spark for intellectual depth, art and unusual perspectives.
ocean.openness_traitDesc: Openness to new experiences, ideas and creativity

story.b1: 15 million people live in Istanbul. 5 million in Ankara. 4 million in Izmir. Millions of stories cross paths in these cities every day, yet most of the time we never even meet. Our social lives have shrunk: colleagues, old school friends, family acquaintances. The same faces, the same conversations. To meet someone new, we either retreat into an app or trust luck, and both end in disappointment. We set out to change that.
story.b2: Ahenk offers three meetup formats: Group tables for 4–6 people, Duo for 2, and Bring a Buddy for 4. At group tables, people brought together by the algorithm meet. In Duo meetups, the algorithm matches you as a pair: deep, personal, mutual. Every format takes place face to face at a restaurant or café, in a public setting. No closed doors, no uncertainty. Just real people in a real place.
story.b3: Our matching relies on science, not hunches. The OCEAN (Big Five) personality model is the gold standard of psychology research, validated on millions of people since the 1980s: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Emotional Balance. These five dimensions make up your personality profile, and the algorithm builds on it, also factoring in your age, field of work, venue preference and expectations. The result: not a random table, but one made for you.
story.b4: Everyone who joins verifies their phone number, shows their ID and completes a short video verification. Everyone at your table has been through this process and confirmed as real. No anonymous accounts, no fake profiles. After each meetup there's a review system: if there's someone you don't want to be matched with again, you say so and you'll never meet them again. If you report something serious, our team steps in, the account is closed permanently and that person can't sign up again.
story.priceBody: Similar platforms in Türkiye charge far more and perform far worse. At Ahenk, the Group Package is {group} TL, the Duo Package {one} TL and the Bring a Buddy Package {kanka} TL. The Double Pass Package gives you Group + Duo together for {icerde} TL. Alongside one-time packages there's also the Premium subscription: 1 Group + 1 Duo + 1 Bring a Buddy Table every month. No hidden fees beyond that. You cover your own venue bill. We just set the table.

story.q2: Safety isn't an option. It's a standard.

locd.title: Your location is used for Emergency Help
locd.s1b: Your location is used only for the Emergency Help feature.
locd.s2b: It is collected only when you send an Emergency Help request at a table, at the moment of the request. After the request is sent, your location continues to be collected about every 10 seconds until the request is resolved. If you grant "Always" permission, your location is also collected in the background, while the app is closed or not in use; on Android, if the phone restarts, location sending for an open request resumes without you having to open the app. Location collection stops when the request is resolved. Other participants' locations are not collected.
locd.s3b: Your location is sent to the Ahenk emergency help team, monitored by our team and is shared with the police. To find the street address of your location, the coordinates are sent to the OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) address service.
